exam.title: Community Library — Reading Practice
exam.description: Read the original passage, complete the table and answer the questions.

sections.title: Reading
sections.instructions: Read the passage carefully. Follow the instructions for each question group.

groups.title: Questions 1–2: Library services
groups.instructions: Complete the table. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
groups.passageText: The community library opens at nine on weekdays. Visitors can borrow gardening tools as well as books. On Saturdays, a volunteer runs a workshop about repairing bicycles. The quiet room is upstairs, while group activities take place downstairs. To join the library, residents show a document with their address. Membership is free. The library has recently added two services: tool lending and a bicycle workshop.

groups.title: Questions 3–6

groups.passageText: The community library opens at nine on weekdays. Visitors can borrow gardening tools as well as books. On Saturdays, a volunteer runs a workshop about repairing bicycles. The quiet room is upstairs, while group activities take place downstairs. To join the library, residents show a document with their address. Membership is free. The library has recently added two services: tool lending and a bicycle workshop.

questions.prompt: Residents must pay to join the library.
What information must a resident's document show? Write ONE WORD ONLY.
